summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.

Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/artifacts

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/init.py

Python · Tier A

Package boundary for generated-file publication, registry access and lifecycle services. Importing this package adds no worker or registry; runtime/API owners construct the concrete services. The immutable file versions here are separate from tool-result evidence and from the repository's top-level generated artifacts folder.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/api.py

Python · Tier A

Serve scoped generated files through portal ownership and artifact-specific credentials.

Responsibilities

  • Compose artifact session, download, preview/export and retention API behavior over ArtifactStore.

Boundaries

  • Artifact rendering does not authorize execution or prove completion. The repository top- level artifacts output directory is unrelated to this production API package.

Lifecycle

  • Accept the outer portal owner's authenticated scope or validate an artifact-specific credential/session, then enforce conversation scope before serving the selected version.

State

  • Active Controllers keep legacy artifact-session hashes in RAM and invalidate them on recovery; standalone SQL retains its expiring session table. Portal owner sessions have a separate authority. MaintenanceWorker schedules retention rather than request handlers.

Security

  • Reject cross-site access and retain the outer portal middleware's login/origin checks. Legacy local bootstrap requires direct loopback peer/host and no configured artifact token; this inner path cannot bypass portal login. Forwarded headers do not confer trust.

Collaborators

  • artifacts/store.py owns immutable identities; export.py and preview.py shape bounded output; maintenance.py controls retention lifecycle.

Public surface

  • ArtifactAccess implements credential, require and session boundaries used when registering artifact API routes. Retain of_artifact_session and existing API identifiers.

@see src/agent_runtime/artifacts/store.py

@see src/agent_runtime/artifacts/maintenance.py

@see src/manual/content/architecture/25-artifacts-output.md

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/collector.py

Python · Tier A

One deterministic reconciler for foreground tools and durable job termination.

Details

Writer admission and collection share a process-safe run lock. Writer intents, verified indexes and retry state belong to the native RAM authority on active Controllers, or its standalone SQL adapter. Snapshot/transfer IO holds the collector lock outside hub publication; the lock is released while tools execute. Saved target identities and terminal evidence govern recovery without tool replay.

Symbol Line Documentation

target_key 42 Use a captured artifact target identity when present, otherwise hash the execution Gateway/local- adapter fields so different targets retain independent collection state.
target_context 53 Rebind a saved execution target without filling missing historical fields from a later UI selection.
execution_target 60 Capture target context and its stable collection identity, resolving configured node/URL defaults for nonlocal execution while preserving outbound transport semantics.
locked 88 Serialize writer admission and collection per run with a thread lock plus process-safe state lock in a private collection-lock directory. Snapshot/transfer IO runs under this collector lock, not a hub publication lock.
load 101 Read detached saved state for the exact run/target from RAM or SQL, or initialize empty writer/index/baseline/status maps. No snapshot or tool replay occurs on read.
save 129 Persist collector state and workspace-deletion events under the existing run/target identity. RAM publication rejects missing/retired/tombstoned workspaces; standalone SQL uses its own immediate transaction.
supported 185 Require a bound registry and either explicit local execution or a callable Gateway artifact operation with compatible discovery tags. Historical snapshots without a tag list retain their existing negotiation behavior.
snapshot 198 Request a managed-output inventory from the selected Gateway, or the explicit local workspace path, and validate its entries before using them for attribution.
validate_snapshot 221 Require at most 20,000 canonical safe relative file entries with string revisions, nonnegative integer sizes and integer modification times. Reject disallowed path components before any content transfer.
producer 250 Capture the operation/activity/receipt/decision/tool/target identifiers available at writer admission; absent optional IDs remain absent rather than being inferred from later output.
problem 264 Expose existing ArtifactError or Gateway-authentication diagnostics; replace unrelated exception text with a stable generic collection message.
collection_failure 274 Build retry-pending attachment status, retaining structured authentication phase/category/status when applicable. This does not turn a successful tool receipt into a failed execution.
begin 290 Under the run collector lock, save original target/quotas and register an active writer before a relevant supported operation. The first writer captures output/temp baselines; ordinary snapshot failures leave conservative attribution, while auth failures propagate. Retain submitted Python source only, never injected inputs/wrappers.
is_pending 333 Treat running/unknown job/process facts, detached terminals and uncertain effects as continuing writer ownership; absence of a synchronous response is not terminal evidence.
reconcile 349 Run collection and independently report its status. Gateway authentication failure persists retry-pending attachment state and invalidates attribution baselines, preserving the original command outcome; unrelated errors retain the caller’s failure handling.
report_collection 369 Emit only retry-pending or recovered collection observations under the target-correlated resource identity. These runtime messages are distinct from the producing tool’s result.

Attribute bytes to one writer only when baseline/change/settled evidence agrees; otherwise use run reconciliation. Retain retry state and immutable IDs on failures, and record missing workspace files without deleting saved versions.
finish 561 Apply observed writer terminal/uncertain, executed and sensitivity facts, then reconcile under the same run lock. Observe concrete temp references only from eligible non-Files receipts or tracked terminal observations; managed directories are still collected separately.
after_result 642 Add collection status and registered artifact references to a raw tool preview without changing its execution outcome. Bind Office/PDF output identities only when the collector actually registered the matching logical path; collection failures become separate notes.
finish_job 685 Reconcile only terminal jobs with existing tracked collector intent, including cancellation- worker calls without a live loop. Restore the saved target and quotas, preserve legacy/untracked job receipts and return attachment failures independently of job truth.
recover 738 Resolve unfinished writers only from durable terminal job/receipt evidence, then retry collection without executing tools. Unknown outcomes keep writers pending; missing terminal snapshots invalidate exact-producer attribution.
retry_run 784 Retry each saved target’s collection using its original execution snapshot. Explicit Retry and recovery share this path; they do not call a model, rerun the producing command or borrow the current UI target.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/config.py

Python · Tier A

Define validated artifact storage and export quotas for registry/collector callers. Environment defaults are evaluated when ArtifactLimits is constructed; settings may supply explicit values. Positive byte/count bounds reject invalid configuration without allocating files.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ArtifactLimits 15 Validate per-file, per-run count/byte and ZIP-export quotas. Missing fields read AOR_ARTIFACT_* environment values at model construction; explicit fields override those defaults, unknown fields and nonpositive limits are rejected. These limits bound storage/transfer, not model context.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/export.py

Python · Tier A

Build authorized run-scoped ZIP downloads from each logical path’s latest version and an allowlisted manifest. Sanitize extraction names, reject unavailable members and enforce conservative preflight plus actual output limits. Private temporary staging completes and rechecks authorization before streaming; exports include sensitive bytes under the same download permission.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ExportTooLarge 23 Identify a bounded ZIP-export refusal with the existing user recovery instruction to download individual files.
BoundedWriter 32 Wrap a private seekable ZIP target and reject writes that would extend past the export ceiling. Other file methods delegate to the target so zipfile can manage its directory/header offsets.
BoundedWriter.write 38 Check target offset plus write length against the hard output limit before forwarding any bytes.
category 49 Map normalized stored MIME types to the shared UI/export categories; do not infer preview eligibility from filename extensions.
archive_paths 72 Validate logical relative paths, sanitize every ZIP component, prefix Windows device names and disambiguate Unicode/case/path-prefix collisions. Reserve artifact-manifest.json; conflicting entries receive stable artifact-ID-based flat names.
manifest 113 Build the allowlisted export manifest for selected latest versions, including identities, sizes/digests, sensitivity and bounded producer fields. Creation time makes each generated manifest a fresh export record, not an original execution receipt.
selection 143 Authorize the run/conversation and select each logical path’s highest version, including unavailable latest versions so export can reject incomplete bundles instead of silently substituting older files.
write_files 155 Stream each selected verified artifact into its assigned ZIP path, independently rechecking recorded size and digest. Any mismatch aborts the entire temporary archive.
export_info 173 Estimate an uncompressed-plus-metadata export budget and report missing latest versions. This conservative preflight can reject a bundle that might compress smaller; BoundedWriter separately enforces actual archive bytes.
build_run_archive 199 Authorize/select latest files, reject missing/oversized preflight, build a bounded private temporary ZIP and manifest, then recheck run access. Return a rewound stream on success; close it on every construction failure.
run_response 230 Stream the completed ZIP with an encoded safe filename and private/no-store/same-origin headers. The response iterator and background task both close the staging stream.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/maintenance.py

Python · Tier A

Apply conversation artifact-retention policy without making request reads scan the filesystem. The worker delegates active-controller cleanup to the RAM save/checkpoint coordinator; standalone SQL retains its serialized maintenance pass. Active, uncertain, scheduled and referenced work protects files. Policy updates and metadata retirement are separate from eventual physical removal, and errors remain visible for later retry.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
retention 36 Read a conversation’s saved policy or the conversation-retention default plus the last recorded cleanup result from RAM or SQL. This is a projection, not a cleanup pass.
save_retention 63 Validate one supported conversation/7/30/90/forever policy and publish it through the current state owner. Return the fresh policy projection; expiry work happens later.
cleanup 102 Delegate active RAM work to its maintenance owner; standalone SQL serializes registry retirement and file cleanup in one write transaction. Protect resumable/unknown/referenced work, quarantine missing versions and remove eligible expired/orphan namespaces conservatively. Filesystem removal cannot be rolled back if a later SQL commit fails.
MaintenanceWorker 253 Own the artifact maintenance wake loop and last-result reporting. Active controllers delegate cleanup preparation to the save/cleanup coordinator; standalone stores collect task/schedule/monitor protections before scanning.
MaintenanceWorker.start 262 Start the maintenance thread through the runtime work owner; callers own single-start lifecycle coordination.
MaintenanceWorker.stop 271 Signal the worker and join it for a bounded timeout. An in-progress filesystem unit may finish before the thread exits.
MaintenanceWorker.run_once 279 Dispatch due RAM cleanup through the checkpoint-aware coordinator, or gather standalone task/lane/event/monitor protections under the caller queue lock before cleanup. No live execution is launched.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/materialize.py

Python · Tier A

Transfer a verified current-run artifact to a unique PDF destination inside the selected Gateway workspace. Scoped authenticated transfer checks chunk offsets and final digest; cancellation/errors return a locality limitation while preserving the Controller artifact. The caller receives usable paths only after commit.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
materialize 24 Copy an immutable artifact from the exact current run/conversation to a unique create-only PDF path on the selected Gateway. Verify chunk acknowledgements and final size/hash before returning usable paths; failures leave the source artifact intact and return a locality limitation, with best-effort destination abort.
transfer_source 42 Copy an already-authorized stream through the existing create-only transfer protocol.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/memory_maintenance.py

Python · Tier A

Prepare or perform artifact cleanup through per-namespace RAM ownership fences. Retention projections join native, task, schedule and monitor protection; file IO happens outside optimistic hub callbacks. A configured save/cleanup planner binds retirement and removal to recovery evidence, while fallback passes yield between units when foreground execution starts.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

_external_protected 152 Check task, schedule and monitor ownership in the same hub transaction as artifact cleanup. Reject mismatched repository hubs; uncompleted tasks, unresolved lanes and active/resumable prompting owners protect the conversation.
cleanup 228 Use the configured save/cleanup coordinator when present. The fallback enters maintenance activity, checks for foreground work between units and reports deferral while preserving already committed metadata/removals.
_cleanup_work 295 Not yet documented

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Keep artifact version, scope, quota, session and collection metadata on the shared Controller RAM authority. Immutable blobs live on disk; registration performs slow IO before a retryable metadata publication that rechecks ownership and quotas. Derived indexes support summaries, ordered history and expiry. Failed or deduplicated publication cleans staging while crash leftovers remain maintenance work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/metadata.py

Python · Tier A

Share the artifact metadata-patch shape guard between RAM and standalone SQL registries. The validator permits only display name, explicit sensitivity and retirement, with an integer expected revision. Registry transactions still own run scope and compare-and-update authority.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
validate 13 Require a nonnegative integer revision and a nonempty patch containing only bounded display_name, Boolean sensitive or status=deleted. This validates shape without authorizing a run or checking its current revision; both repositories perform those checks transactionally.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/presentation.py

Python · Tier A

Enrich completed answers with registered attachments without changing canonical completion evidence. project may collect concrete missing outputs on their original targets; retained_projection uses saved bindings only for history. Plan responses keep their digest-bound form, and optional attachment failure leaves the original answer intact.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
retained_projection 14 For terminal non-Plan runs, enrich the saved final display using durable source-to-artifact bindings only. Return source/content only when they differ; no Gateway lookup, file discovery or canonical answer mutation occurs.
project 35 After completion validation, publish missing concrete output references only through their recorded execution targets and then enrich display Markdown. Ambiguous multi-target paths are not assigned to the current UI target. Any optional publication failure returns the original text without altering completion truth.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/preview.py

Python · Tier A

Choose safe display modes and bounded data previews for immutable registered artifacts. MIME, sensitivity and byte ceilings determine eligibility; CSV/JSON/text readers expose truncation and formatting limits. Returned text is presentation data, not executed code, and contains the authorized original values rather than model-redacted copies.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
policy 36 Choose preview kind and size ceiling from stored MIME metadata. Sensitive files and oversized image/PDF/HTML payloads are download-only; unsupported formats remain files. Text/CSV/JSON use the separate bounded prefix reader rather than a whole-file preview limit.
data_preview 63 Read at most 64 KiB plus one byte and render inert UTF-8 replacement text (including Mermaid source), strict CSV or bounded JSON formatting. CSV clips 50 data rows, 32 columns and 1,024 characters per cell while distinguishing sampled counts; truncated or deeply nested JSON retains text. This does not redact stored values or rewrite the artifact.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/references.py

Python · Tier A

Extract bounded concrete output paths and enrich display Markdown using saved artifact bindings. Receipt traversal excludes execution inputs and diagnostics; assistant fenced examples stay inert. Paths are candidates only: this module performs no filesystem access, Gateway call, registration or execution.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
prose_parts 26 Split Markdown into prose and fenced-code spans, preserving bytes and treating unmatched backtick/tilde fences as inert examples.
paths 50 Extract at most 64 distinct absolute POSIX/Windows paths from bounded receipt/text traversal: 262,144 string characters, 2,048 visited values and depth 12. Skip command/input/environment/error fields and assistant fenced examples; parse quoted/link paths without also adding whitespace prefixes. Discovery does not prove a path exists or is publishable.
enrich 143 Rewrite only bound Markdown paths to artifact URIs and append each otherwise-unlinked artifact once near its paragraph. Preserve fenced examples and unbound paths; sanitized attachment labels do not change stored content or evidence.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/runtime.py

Python · Tier A

Connect native run identity to artifact workspaces on the selected execution target. Bind registry context, negotiate workspace/temp support, validate chunked remote reads and translate Files paths. Explicit local adapters are the only Controller-local fallback; transfer/protocol failures prevent publication rather than changing targets.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

Explicit embedded-local adapters may use Controller files; unsupported legacy callers return None rather than treating remote paths as local.
tmp_mapping_options 97 Send the temp-mapping option only when the accepted Gateway capability snapshot advertises it, keeping older protocol peers free of unknown request fields.

Local reads require an explicit embedded-local flag; remote reads fence revision, path, offsets, total size and chunk bounds before registry publication.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/source_capture.py

Python · Tier A

Publish executed Python attempts’ exact submitted source as immutable artifacts. The collector supplies the operation producer and sensitivity; capture derives a stable source path and sends UTF-8 bytes to the registry. No generated execution wrapper or resolved input values are substituted.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
capture 14 Register the exact submitted Python source as UTF-8 under a stable operation-derived source/python path, preserving producer identity and sensitivity. Execution wrappers and resolved inputs are not substituted; the collector calls this only for observed executed attempts.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/store.py

Python · Tier A

Own generated-file namespaces, immutable versions, scoped grants and verified download streams. ArtifactStore selects the RAM adapter for an active Controller and retains standalone SQL behavior otherwise. Registration stages and hashes bounded bytes before publishing metadata/events; reads verify a private copy before serving. Preview policy and retention are separate owners, and publication never proves task completion.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

File storage and registry publication have distinct failure boundaries.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/temp_publication.py

Python · Tier A

Stage finalized task-temp files and explicit output references through the original target’s artifact protocol. Saved collector state retains source/staged revisions, sensitivity, retry status and final registry associations. Bounded staging and conservative provenance separate finding a path from proving its producer; history uses retained IDs without resolving old paths again.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

Revalidate unfinished staging, retain source revisions and attribution evidence, and return bounded recoverable errors; authentication failures stop the pass. This does not crawl global temp or replay tools.
